# codigate_log_destination (Resource)

Streams access and audit logs to an HTTPS webhook, a syslog server (TLS) or S3-compatible storage. Paid plans.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "codigate_log_destination" "siem" {
  type        = "https"
  name        = "SIEM"
  streams     = ["access", "audit"]
  url         = "https://siem.example.com/ingest"
  auth_header = "Authorization: Bearer ${var.siem_token}"
}

resource "codigate_log_destination" "archive" {
  type       = "s3"
  name       = "Archive"
  streams    = ["access"]
  endpoint   = "https://s3.eu-central-1.amazonaws.com"
  region     = "eu-central-1"
  bucket     = "example-codigate-logs"
  access_key = var.s3_access_key
  secret_key = var.s3_secret_key
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name (at most 100 characters).
- `streams` (Set of String) Which logs to send: access, audit or both.
- `type` (String) https, syslog or s3. Changing it replaces the destination.

### Optional

- `access_key` (String) s3: access key id.
- `app_name` (String) syslog: APP-NAME field (default codigate).
- `auth_header` (String, Sensitive) https: extra header on one line, "Header-Name: value". Never returned by the API.
- `bucket` (String) s3: bucket.
- `ca_pem` (String) Private CA (PEM) to trust for the destination's TLS certificate.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether logs are sent (default true).
- `endpoint` (String) s3: endpoint URL (https://...).
- `host` (String) syslog: host name.
- `port` (Number) syslog: TCP port for syslog over TLS (default 6514).
- `prefix` (String) s3: key prefix.
- `region` (String) s3: region.
- `secret_key` (String, Sensitive) s3: secret access key. Never returned by the API.
- `url` (String) https: webhook URL (https://...).

### Read-Only

- `ca_sha256` (String) SHA-256 of the stored CA.
- `id` (String) Destination id.
- `signing_secret` (String, Sensitive) https: secret that signs each request (Codigate-Signature). Only known after create.
- `status` (String) Delivery status.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import codigate_log_destination.siem ldst_0123456789abcdef
```
